features.desc: +3 HP maximum and +1 per later Sorcerer level. Icy or snowy Difficult Terrain costs no extra movement, and on ice each foot of movement carries you 2 feet.

features.name: Cold-Hearted
features.desc: Resistance to Cold damage. When your spell deals Cold damage to a Large or smaller creature, spend Sorcery Points to cut its Speed by 15 feet each until the end of its next turn; reaching 0 also deals 2d6 Cold. Create Ice can freeze water 5 feet deep, holding up to Large creatures.

features.name: Flash Freeze
features.desc: Moving on ice doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks. When a creature within 5 feet hits you, take a Reaction to deal Cold equal to Cha mod + half your Sorcerer level and use Create Ice.

features.name: Frozen Soul
features.desc: Immunity to Cold and Resistance to Fire. Wall of Ice is always prepared without its Material component, and once per Long Rest castable without a slot with non-contiguous panels if flat.

features.name: Astral Griffon Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Identify, Locate Object, Magic Missile, Rope Trick; 5 Blink, Clairvoyance; 7 Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum, Leomund's Secret Chest; 9 Legend Lore, Passwall.

features.name: Astral Missile
features.desc: Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest cast Magic Missile without a slot; its darts can target creatures you can't see.

features.name: Extradimensional Acuity
features.desc: A personal pocket dimension holding 50 pounds in 1 cubic foot, reached by hand. Putting another extradimensional container inside destroys both and locks you out for 7 days. You sense other extradimensional spaces within 60 feet.

features.name: Planar Escape
features.desc: Once per Short or Long Rest, when you take damage, take a Reaction to halve it and slip into an overlapping demiplane, unseen by the plane you left, until the end of your next turn or until you return.

features.name: Extradimensional Mastery
features.desc: Resistance to Force damage. Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, a Magic action grants Truesight 30 feet and Advantage on sight-based Perception for 10 minutes. You sense the contents of extradimensional magic items within 10 feet.

features.name: Pocketeer
features.desc: Your pocket holds 250 pounds in 10 cubic feet. As a Magic action pull an unworn object within 30 feet into it (a carrier makes a Wis save, and that version is once per Short or Long Rest); unretrieved by the end of your next turn, it pops out within 5 feet or into your hand.

features.name: Arcane Artisan
features.desc: Learn Mending (or another Wizard cantrip) for free. Proficiency with three Artisan's Tools, swapping one each Long Rest. Crafting with proficient tools, cut each day's required hours by your Int mod (min 1; at least 2 hours).

features.name: Minor Creation
features.desc: When you cast a level 1+ spell, create a 5-foot cube of any inanimate material within 30 feet (60 at Wizard 10) or attached to another of your cubes. Each weighs 25 pounds, holds ten times that, gives cover, has AC 10 + Int mod and 1 HP, and lasts an hour; you can have as many as your Wizard level and dismiss them as a Bonus Action. Int mod times (min 1) per Long Rest (or regain uses with slots) you can detonate dismissed cubes instead: creatures within 10 feet make a Dex save for 1d6 + half your Wizard level Force, half on success.

features.name: Material Enhancement
features.desc: Twice per Short or Long Rest, as a Magic action give an object one benefit per use until your next rest: weapon +1 (+2 at Wizard 10, +3 at 14); armor +1 AC (same scaling); no Stealth Disadvantage; light 20/20 feet; half weight and no Strength requirement or Heavy penalty; returns when thrown; or cosmetic changes. Each benefit only once per recharge.

features.name: Dematerialize
features.desc: Your spells deal double damage to objects and structures, and your damage to Constructs adds 1d8 Force.

features.name: Rematerialize
features.desc: Once per Long Rest, when a Large or smaller nonmagical object or structure is destroyed within 60 feet, a Reaction stores its debris; within 8 hours a Magic action rebuilds it intact within 60 feet. Dropped from the air, it deals 1d6/2d6/3d6 Bludgeoning per 10 feet fallen (by size) to those beneath on a failed Dex save, half on success.

features.name: Alchemical Experiments
features.desc: Alchemist's Supplies with proficiency; craft Potions of Healing with them instead of an Herbalism Kit.

features.name: Volatile Serum
features.desc: When you Rage, inject one serum for the Rage (swap as a Bonus Action). Ferocity: ignore Difficult Terrain and trigger Cleave alongside another mastery on melee hits. Monstrosity: grow to Large (space permitting), +5 feet reach, and once per turn add your Rage Damage bonus to a missed Strength attack roll. Reconstruction: on injecting and at the start of each turn, spend and roll a Hit Die to heal it + Con mod, excess as temp HP (not the turn after Acid or Fire damage).

features.name: Augmentation Compounds
features.desc: Also activate a compound with your serum. Stimulated Senses: Blindsight 30 feet (or +30). Maddening Fumes: a 30-foot Emanation halves enemies' Speed, and those starting a turn there make a Wis save (DC 8 + Con mod + PB) or have Disadvantage attacking others until their next turn. Corrosive Expulsion: replace an attack with a 15-foot Cone or 30-foot Line of acid; Dex save for d8s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, half on success.

features.name: Reactive Catalyst
features.desc: When you take damage or become Blinded, Deafened, Poisoned, or Stunned, take a Reaction to Rage first, ending those conditions. Advantage on Con saves while Raging.

features.name: Biochemical Admixture
features.desc: Activate two serums at once. While Raging, a creature within 5 feet that damages you with a melee attack takes 1d12 Acid (once per turn).

features.name: Handy Haints
features.desc: When you give Bardic Inspiration, summon a haint around the target for 1 minute with a 15-foot aura (it ends when you use its Reaction). Grump: Advantage on Intimidation and Str saves in the aura, and a Reaction adds an Inspiration die + Cha mod to one creature's damage. Sad Sack: Half Cover against ranged attacks in the aura, and a Reaction reduces damage to a creature by an Inspiration die + Cha mod. Scamp: +10 feet Speed for those starting a turn in it, and a Reaction lets a creature reroll a failed save.

features.name: Whistling Wanderer
features.desc: On a Long Rest turn a bag into a bindle that works as a Handy Haversack (one at a time; it fails beyond 1 mile). You can whistle Verbal components; observers need DC 15 Arcana to recognize the casting.

features.name: Homeward Bound
features.desc: On each Long Rest mark the spot (up to Cha mod marks). Once per Long Rest cast Teleportation Circle to a mark as a phantom train. From Bard 9, Teleportation Circle is always prepared and can target your marks.

features.name: Ride the Rails
features.desc: Once per Long Rest (or a level 3+ slot), as a Magic action a ghost train runs a 120-foot by 10-foot Line: you and up to six willing creatures within 30 feet teleport to a space along it, and others in the Line make a Wis save or are Deafened, pushed 10 feet, and take three Inspiration dice of Psychic.

features.name: Last Stop
features.desc: Once per Long Rest (or a level 7+ slot), as a Magic action up to six creatures within 300 feet make a Cha save or are cursed for up to 1 minute (repeat save each turn): Psychic damage Frightens them of its source, and the first Psychic hit gives them Vulnerability to Psychic.

features.name: Community Almanac
features.desc: Herbalism Kit with proficiency, plus Nature or Survival.

features.name: Harvest Domain Spells
features.desc: After each rest pick Sowing, Growing, or Reaping and have that column prepared up to your level. Sowing: 3 Druidcraft, Goodberry, Lesser Restoration; 5 Harvest Moonglow; 7 Death Ward; 9 Awaken. Growing: 3 Guidance, Entangle, Summer Winds; 5 Plant Growth; 7 Sanctum of the Shepherd; 9 Mass Cure Wounds. Reaping: 3 Chill Touch, Inflict Wounds, Hold Person; 5 Culling Sickle; 7 Consuming Pyre; 9 Field of Reaping.

features.name: Cornucopia
features.desc: Once per Long Rest, start a Short Rest by conjuring food for twice your PB creatures; at the rest's end divide Cleric-level d4s of healing among those who ate.

features.name: Bountiful Harvest
features.desc: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Magic action: up to six creatures within 60 feet gain Heroic Inspiration (once per Long Rest each) plus one aspect's boon, which becomes your aspect. Sowing: temp HP equal to PB + Wis mod. Growing: +1d4 to attacks and checks until the end of your next turn. Reaping: +PB Necrotic on their first damage before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Blessing of the Seasons
features.desc: Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, when a creature within 30 feet fails a save of your aspect's types (Sowing Dex/Cha, Growing Con/Int, Reaping Wis/Str), take a Reaction to let it reroll; afterward it heals PB d4s.

features.name: Eternal Wheel
features.desc: Once per Long Rest (or a level 7+ slot), Bountiful Harvest adds: Sowing, Regenerate for 1 minute; Growing, Advantage on saves and checks for up to 1 hour (Concentration); Reaping, Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Poison for 1 hour.

features.name: Circle of the Old Ways Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Ancestral Communion, Barkskin, Shield of Faith, Shillelagh, Spike Growth; 5 Magic Circle, Plant Growth; 7 Freedom of Movement, Private Sanctum; 9 Awaken, Tree Stride.

features.name: Bough and Branch
features.desc: Casting Shillelagh can grow a wooden Shield in your free hand for its duration; you can't be disarmed of either unless Incapacitated, you ignore Somatic components of Druid spells, and the weapon is your Druidic Focus.

features.name: Wood Wose
features.desc: As a Bonus Action or while casting Shillelagh, spend a Wild Shape use for 10 minutes: unarmored AC 10 + Dex + Wis; Shillelagh hits coat the target in sap so it has Disadvantage attacking anyone but you until your next turn; Advantage on Str and Con saves.

features.name: Oak and Thorn
features.desc: During Wood Wose: two attacks per Attack action, and once per turn a melee weapon hit adds 1d6 Piercing.

features.name: Deepwood Elder
features.desc: During Wood Wose: once per turn a melee hit forces a Str save or Prone; melee attackers within 5 feet take 1d8 Piercing (once per turn); and you gain Wis mod + PB temp HP on activation and each turn.

features.name: Ancient Protector
features.desc: During Wood Wose: grow to Large with +5 feet reach, Resistance to Bludgeoning and Piercing, and a Reaction melee attack when a sap-coated creature in reach makes an attack roll.

features.name: Bewitched Effigy
features.desc: As a Bonus Action spend a Wild Shape use to set a Small wicker effigy within 30 feet for 1 minute (AC 15, HP 5 x Druid level, Vulnerable to Fire) with a 30-foot dimly lit aura. Sacrifice: Reaction to deal 1d8 + Wis mod Fire to a creature in it that takes damage. Soothe: on creation and as a Bonus Action later, heal a creature in it 1d6 (twice your spellcasting modifier times). Ward: +1 AC to you and allies in it.

features.name: Circle of Wicker Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Bane, Bless, Summer Winds, Zone of Truth; 5 Bestow Curse, Tiny Hut; 7 Death Ward, Sanctum of the Shepherd; 9 Hold Monster, Lucky Charm.

features.name: Wicker Token
features.desc: On each Long Rest make PB tokens; you can cast Touch spells on anyone carrying one on your plane.

features.name: Wicker Rising
features.desc: Sacrifice becomes 2d8 + Wis mod. Soothe heals 1d8 and can spend 5 of the effigy's HP to end Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned. Ward also grants Resistance to one non-Force damage type.

features.name: Soulbound Poppet
features.desc: As a Magic action spend a Wild Shape use to make a doll of a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute (AC 10, 10 HP): it has Disadvantage attacking whoever carries the doll, and that carrier's first damage to it each turn adds 2d10 Necrotic.

features.name: Wicker Zenith
features.desc: Switch the effigy's aura at the start of your turn. Sacrifice becomes 3d8 + Wis mod; Soothe ends Charmed or Frightened on those starting a turn there; Ward also grants Advantage on saves of one chosen ability.

features.name: Death Knight
features.desc: Draugr Dice: four d6 (six d8 at Fighter 5, eight at 9, eight d10 at 11, ten at 13, twelve d12 at 17); regain one on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest; save DC 8 + Con mod + PB. Dark Rider: once per Short or Long Rest (or spend a die), as a Bonus Action summon a ghostly Undead Warhorse for 1 hour with B/P/S Resistance that can only Dash, Disengage, or Dodge; spend a die on its Dash to add 5 feet per point rolled. Grave Guard: Reaction to reduce damage by a die + Con mod. Soul Reaper: give up an attack to grip a creature within 60 feet with ghostly hands: Str save or a die + Con mod Necrotic and Grappled for 1 minute, half damage only on success.

features.name: Siphoning Souls
features.desc: When a non-Construct, non-Undead enemy within 30 feet dies, a Reaction regains a Draugr Die. Spend a die to add it to an ability check.

features.name: Tomb Castellan
features.desc: Your steed ignores Difficult Terrain, and when it Dashes, Disengages, or Dodges you can spend a die to teleport it 60 feet; chosen creatures within 10 feet of where it appears make a Con save for a die + Con mod Necrotic, half on success. Grave Guard returns half the prevented damage as Psychic to the attacker. Creatures held by Soul Reaper take PB Psychic at the start of their turns, plus a die with your Reaction.

features.name: Grave Lord
features.desc: Dark Rider can carry a passenger, and spending a die on its Dash lets it pass through objects and creatures. Grave Guard also grants Resistance to one triggering damage type until your next turn. Soul Reaper's grapple also Restrains.

features.name: Might of the Necropolis
features.desc: You don't age or need air, food, drink, or sleep. When you roll Initiative with fewer than 3 Draugr Dice, refill to 3.

features.name: Contagious Discipline
features.desc: Your Unarmed Strikes can deal Slashing, and Flurry of Blows hits add a Martial Arts die of Necrotic. Miasmic Plague: on an Unarmed Strike hit, spend 1 Focus Point (or forgo the Flurry bonus) for a Con save or 1 minute cursed: Poisoned and once per turn taking a Martial Arts die of extra Necrotic from your Unarmed Strikes, repeating the save each turn.

features.name: Gift of Pestilence
features.desc: Advantage on saves against Poisoned and magical contagions and Resistance to Poison and Necrotic. Talk simply with vermin, and once per Long Rest cast Animal Messenger on a plague-bearing Tiny Beast (Wisdom).

features.name: Potent Plague
features.desc: Your Necrotic and Poison damage ignores Resistance to those types.

features.name: Tolling Censer
features.desc: As a Magic action spend 2 Focus Points: chosen creatures in a 20-foot Emanation make a Con save for two Martial Arts dice Necrotic and Miasmic Plague, half damage only on success.

features.name: Miasmic Contagion
features.desc: Saves against Miasmic Plague have Disadvantage. Spending a Focus Point on Step of the Wind lets you plague chosen creatures you pass within 5 feet of (Con save, once per turn each).

features.name: Epidemic
features.desc: Miasmic Plague ignores immunity to Poisoned, and your Necrotic damage to a plagued creature adds a Martial Arts die.

features.name: Castigate
features.desc: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Magic action: up to Cha mod creatures within 30 feet make a Str save or are shackled in fire with Speed 0 for up to 1 minute (repeat save each turn); a Bonus Action flares the shackles for 2d6 Fire each.

features.name: Incite
features.desc: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Magic action for 10 minutes of Advantage on Investigation and Insight, during which a Bonus Action forces a creature within 10 feet to make a Cha save or be Frightened for 1 minute and unable to lie deliberately (ends if it takes damage or you use this again).

features.name: Oath of Castigation Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Divine Favor, Inflict Wounds; 5 Chain of Conviction, Hold Person; 9 Counterspell, Speak with Dead; 13 Consuming Pyre, Locate Creature; 17 Flame Strike, Hold Monster.

features.name: Kindling Aura
features.desc: You and allies in your Aura of Protection ignore Fire and Radiant Resistance, can deal Fire with weapon hits, and add your Cha mod to Investigation and Insight.

features.name: Fervent Inquisitor
features.desc: When a creature damages you or an ally within 30 feet, a Reaction grants Advantage on your next attack against it. Fire or Radiant damage to a Bloodied creature reveals any lies it knowingly told you in the past 24 hours.

features.name: Fire and Brimstone
features.desc: Once per Long Rest (or a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: Immunity to Fire, +10 feet reach with melee attacks that ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover, and a creature you hit with an Opportunity Attack or that ends its turn in your reach makes a Cha save or falls Prone with Speed 0 until its next turn.

features.name: Grim Harbinger Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Bane; 5 Hold Person; 9 Fear; 13 Intrusive Despair; 17 Dream.

features.name: Omen of Doom
features.desc: Wis mod times (min 1) per Short or Long Rest (or spend a slot), as a Bonus Action doom a creature within 90 feet for 1 hour: once per turn your hits on it add 1d6 Necrotic. A Grim appears within 30 feet of it (AC 13 + Wis mod, HP 5 + 5 x Ranger level, Incorporeal Movement, adds PB to checks and saves; Ominous Rend uses your spell attack for 1d6 + 3 + Wis mod Necrotic and Frightens; Baleful Howl reaction stops a fleeing creature). It Dodges unless commanded with a Bonus Action or by giving up an attack, and vanishes when you die, the target dies, it drops to 0, or you use this again.

features.name: Harbinger of Doom
features.desc: Ominous Rend deals +1d6 Necrotic, your damage to a doomed creature can be Necrotic, and Necrotic from you or the Grim ignores Resistance.

features.name: Grave Bond
features.desc: The Grim gains B/P/S Resistance; you gain Necrotic Resistance; and once per Omen, a Reaction makes the doomed target reroll a successful save with Disadvantage.

features.name: Sealed Fate
features.desc: Ominous Rend deals a further +1d6. Once per Long Rest (or a level 4+ slot), when you cast Omen of Doom the target makes a Cha save or is Vulnerable to the Grim's damage and your Omen damage.

features.name: Hex Slinger
features.desc: Cha mod times (min 1) per Short Rest, when you deal Sneak Attack damage designate two of the dice; their total sets a jinx until the end of the target's next turn. 2 Snake Eyes: it can only move or act or Bonus Act, taking 2d6 Psychic if it attacks your side. 3-4 The Nightmare: Frightened and it uses its Reaction to flee. 5-6 Whiskey Bottle: drops what it holds and fumbles pickups (DC 15 Dex). 7 Cheap Shot: half Speed and attacks against it have Advantage. 8-9 Withered Arm: Disadvantage on Strength D20 Tests. 10-11 Bad Luck: -1d6 on attacks and saves. 12 Dead Man: your next attack before the end of your next turn hits, or crits if it would hit (triple dice on a natural 20).

features.name: Get Jinxed
features.desc: Proficiency with two Gaming Sets. A 1-hour ritual makes a jinx weapon: a Gaming Set that works for you as a Simple Ranged weapon (30/90 feet, 1d8 Force, Vex mastery), a Pistol, or a proficient weapon that deals Force. Learn Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Mysterious Presence, or Prestidigitation (Charisma).

features.name: Borrowed Luck
features.desc: Using Hex Slinger grants Heroic Inspiration; if you already have it you can spend it instead of a Hex Slinger use.

features.name: Pick Your Poison
features.desc: Roll the jinx dice twice and choose. Doubles also deal Psychic equal to half your level, and a 2 or 12 doesn't spend the use.

features.name: The Other Side
features.desc: After a missed attack or failed save, spend and roll any number of Sneak Attack dice to add to it; when hit, spend them to add to your AC. Spent dice return after your next Sneak Attack.

features.name: Blood Well
features.desc: When you deal damage or restore HP, spend your Blood Well to add 1d8 for one target. It refills on a Long Rest or when a creature takes 10+ Necrotic from you at once.

features.name: Crimson Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Aid, Blood Bolt, Cure Wounds, Inflict Wounds, Blood Sacrifice; 5 Crimson Harvest, Vampiric Touch; 7 Death Ward, Sacrificial Siphon; 9 Field of Reaping, Mass Cure Wounds.

features.name: Pool of Blood
features.desc: As a Bonus Action spend your Blood Well to become a pool of blood for up to 1 hour: Speed 10 with climb, swim, and spider climb; B/P/S Resistance; immune to Prone; Advantage on Str, Dex, Con saves; squeeze through cracks and share spaces; but no speaking, attacking, casting, or using items.

features.name: Scarlet Vigor
features.desc: Resistance to Necrotic. After a Short Rest, spend your Blood Well to remove 1 Exhaustion level.

features.name: Vital Siphoning
features.desc: As a Bonus Action spend a Hit Die to refill your Blood Well, or spend the Blood Well to make your next Metamagic this turn free.

features.name: Sanguine Feast
features.desc: Once per Long Rest (or 5 Sorcery Points), as a Magic action chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Con save (with Disadvantage if your Blood Well is spent) for 5d8 Necrotic, half on success; you heal the damage roll if any are hurt.

features.name: Great Fool Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Disguise Self, Hideous Laughter, Rope Trick, Spiritual Weapon, Vicious Mockery; 5 Blink, Stinking Cloud; 7 Phantasmal Killer, Puppet Master; 9 Arcane Hand, Mislead.

features.name: Killing Joke
features.desc: Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest (one back on a Short Rest), when a creature you can see within 60 feet takes damage or fails a save, take a Reaction to cast Vicious Mockery on it.

features.name: Jester's Japes
features.desc: Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Magic action a creature within 60 feet makes a Cha save or is cursed for 1 minute (repeat save each turn): Flower Spurt (Blinded), Clown Shoes (half Speed, Disadvantage on Dex checks and saves), Honk Honk (noisy and can't benefit from Invisible), or Jolly Arms (half damage with weapons and Unarmed Strikes).

features.name: Mocking Banter
features.desc: Once per Short or Long Rest, when a creature damages you, take a Reaction: it makes a Wis save, taking Psychic damage equal to the damage you took, or half on success.

features.name: Send in the Clowns
features.desc: Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action summon three ghostly fools for 1 minute and make up to three melee spell attacks against creatures within 60 feet (repeatable with your action on later turns): 2d10 Psychic and Frightened until its next turn ends, or Prone.

features.name: Horned King Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Animal Friendship, Bane, Spike Growth, Suggestion; 5 Bestow Curse, Fly; 7 Phantasmal Killer, Polymorph; 9 Dominate Person, Scrying.

features.name: Witch Mark
features.desc: On a Long Rest, imbue a held Tiny object with one of your prepared action-time Warlock spells; whoever holds it can cast it once as a Magic action using your modifiers.

features.name: Malediction
features.desc: Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, curse a creature within 60 feet until the end of its next turn as a Magic action, or as a Reaction when it targets you with an attack or spell. Agony: Disadvantage on its next attack or Concentration save. Hate: Disadvantage on its next Int, Wis, or Cha save. Rot: +1d10 Necrotic the next time it takes damage and no healing until its next turn ends.

features.name: Spiteful Curse
features.desc: Once per Long Rest (not spent if it saves), Malediction can cast Bestow Curse instead with 60-foot range, 1-minute duration, and no Concentration; on a successful save it suffers a Malediction curse instead.

features.name: Crown of Horns
features.desc: Once per Long Rest (or a Pact slot), as a Bonus Action for 1 minute: once per turn your damage adds 1d8 Necrotic, and on activation and each turn a creature in a 20-foot aura makes a Cha save or until your next turn is Charmed, has Disadvantage on attacks and checks, or is Frightened and must flee.

features.name: Gather the Coven
features.desc: A 1-hour ritual bonds up to six willing creatures: each can use one chosen Malediction Reaction once per Long Rest; once per Short or Long Rest you can teleport next to a bonded creature as a Bonus Action (free while Crowned); and while your Crown is active their first damage each turn adds 1d10 Necrotic.

features.name: Forbidden Knowledge
features.desc: Learn Deep Speech or another language, and always have one level 1 Warlock spell prepared (swap on a Long Rest).

features.name: Intrusion
features.desc: You have an Intrusion Die that starts at d6 (d8 at Wizard 5, d10 at 11, d12 at 17) and shifts along d2-d3-d4-d6-d8-d10-d12. Risking Intrusion: roll it; on 2+ nothing happens and it shrinks a step; on a 1 it grows a step and you roll a d12 Intrusion effect (from losing actions, warped space, or blindness to a free spell slot, a buffed DC, or a summoned Aberration or Fiend). It regrows a step on a Short Rest and resets on a Long Rest. When you cast a slot spell, risk Intrusion for Overwhelming Mind (Disadvantage on the first save) or Seeking Eye (Advantage on the first attack roll).

features.name: Reality Tear
features.desc: Always have one Warlock spell of level 3 or lower prepared (swap on a Long Rest). Risk Intrusion to cast it without Concentration (lasting up to 1 minute), or once per Long Rest trigger an automatic Intrusion to cast it without a slot.

features.name: Occult Presence
features.desc: Roll Intrusion effects twice and pick, or negate one by gaining 1 Exhaustion. Gain one benefit, swappable on a Long Rest or with an automatic Intrusion as a Bonus Action: immunity to Charmed, Frightened, and possession; Resistance to Necrotic and Psychic; or flight with hover at your Speed.

features.name: Beyond Space
features.desc: Scrying always prepared. Risk Intrusion to treat the target as if you had part of its body, or to cast it as an action. Once per Long Rest during the spell, trigger an automatic Intrusion to teleport yourself and willing creatures within 10 feet to spaces seen through the sensor.

features.name: Alchemical Knowledge
features.desc: Alchemist's Supplies with proficiency, usable as an Arcane Focus and to craft any magic item.

features.name: Quintessence
features.desc: Learn Dissolution; what it destroys (Small or larger) leaves an ounce of Quintessence. Hold up to twice your Int mod (min 2). Spend it as 100 GP of Material components per measure, as 50 GP of materials for scribing or crafting, or to turn one damage type of a spell into Force.

features.name: Albedo
features.desc: When casting with a slot, spend up to half your PB (round up) in Quintessence to raise the slot level by 1 each (max 9).

features.name: Citrinitas
features.desc: Creation and Fabricate always prepared, each once per Long Rest without a slot and as an action. Spend up to Int mod Quintessence on Creation to multiply its duration by 1 + the amount.

features.name: Rubedo
features.desc: After a rest, spend 10 Quintessence to make a philosopher's stone (AC 19, 20 HP, harmed only by Force). While carried: spend up to 2 Quintessence to raise a spell's DC by that much; a Reaction and 5 Quintessence turn a failed save into a success; you stop aging; and it counts as part of your body for Scrying and resurrection, serving as the component.

features.name: Rage of the Giants
features.desc: When you activate Rage, if smaller than Large you can become Large (with your gear) if there is room. While Large your carrying capacity doubles, you have Advantage on Strength checks and saves, and weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks deal one extra damage die.

features.name: Crushing Steps
features.desc: You can move through the space of any creature smaller than you. An enemy whose space you move through makes a Strength save (DC 8 + Strength modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or has the Prone condition and can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

features.name: Titanic Strikes
features.desc: Brutal Strike's Forceful Blow pushes twice as far, and Hamstring Blow reduces the target's Speed to 0 until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Rage of the Titans
features.desc: When you activate Rage, if smaller than Huge you can become Huge (or Large if there isn't room). While Huge your carrying capacity triples, your reach increases by 5 feet, you have Advantage on Strength checks and saves, and your attacks deal two extra damage dice.

features.name: Poetic Provocation
features.desc: You always have Vicious Mockery prepared (or learn another cantrip if you know it). A creature that fails its save against your Vicious Mockery also has Disadvantage on its next Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma save before the end of your next turn. Flyting Master: use Charisma (Performance) in place of Intimidation or Persuasion to provoke, threaten, or sway with words.

features.name: Martial Training
features.desc: Proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor and Shields. You can use a Simple or Martial weapon as a Spellcasting Focus for Bard spells, and you gain the mastery property of one Simple or Martial weapon (change it after a Long Rest).

features.name: Bragi's Rune of Speech
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, expend a Bardic Inspiration for one effect (only one active at a time). Scorn: a creature within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on attacks against you for 1 minute. Eloquence: add your Bardic Inspiration roll to your first Charisma check or save in the next hour. Vitality: you and up to three allies within 30 feet gain Temporary Hit Points equal to a Bardic Inspiration roll.

features.name: Battle Sagas
features.desc: Spend 1 minute reciting the Eddas; creatures of your choice within 60 feet that hear you gain for 1 hour: Resistance to Poison and Immunity to Frightened and Poisoned, +2d10 Hit Point maximum (and Hit Points), and +1d4 once per turn to an attack roll or save. During that hour, when an affected ally fails a d20 test, you can take a Reaction and expend a Bardic Inspiration to let it add the die. Once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Augury, Bane, Bless, Warding Bond; 5 Bestow Curse, Counterspell; 7 Death Ward, Divination; 9 Commune, Modify Memory.

features.name: Tailor the Skein
features.desc: After a Long Rest, roll a d6 twice and record the results as Skeins. As a Reaction after learning the result of an attack, damage roll, save, or ability check by a creature you can see within 60 feet, add or subtract one Skein from it. Each Skein is used once. The die becomes a d8 at level 7, d10 at 11, and d12 at 15.

features.name: Plucking at Threads
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, expend a Channel Divinity: allies within 30 feet have Advantage on attack rolls and saves until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Intertwined Fate
features.desc: As a Magic action, expend a spell slot and choose two creatures you can see within 30 feet. The primary makes a Constitution save (it may choose to fail), taking 1d8 Force damage per slot level or half on a success. The secondary regains that many Hit Points, or gains them as Temporary Hit Points if uninjured.

features.name: Skein Weaver
features.desc: When you use Plucking at Threads, enemies within 30 feet make a Charisma save or have Disadvantage on attack rolls and saves for 1 minute (save at the end of each turn); a success grants immunity for 24 hours.

features.name: Mantle of the Wolf
features.desc: As an action, expend a Wild Shape use to manifest a spectral wolf's head for 10 minutes (ends if dismissed, re-manifested, or you are Incapacitated). You add your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) to Strength (Athletics) checks and Strength saves, and you can replace one melee attack with a bite using Wisdom: 1d8 + Wisdom modifier Force.

features.name: Circle of Fenris Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Beast Sense, Enhance Ability, Ensnaring Strike, Hunter's Mark; 5 Conjure Animals, Fear; 7 Dominate Beast; 9 Commune with Nature.

features.name: Improved Mantle
features.desc: While the mantle is active: bite attacks deal double damage to objects and structures and ignore damage thresholds; Darkvision 60 feet (or +30 feet); and +10 feet Speed.

features.name: Defend the Pack
features.desc: When a creature attacks an ally within 30 feet, take a Reaction and spend a Wild Shape use: a phantom wolf deals 4d8 Force (no roll or save) and knocks it Prone. 6d8 from level 14.

features.name: Children of the Great Wolf
features.desc: Once per day when you take on your Mantle of the Wolf, also summon a loyal fenrikyn that obeys your telepathic commands for as long as the mantle lasts (or until dismissed, destroyed, you leave the plane, are killed or Unconscious, or it is more than 120 feet away).

features.name: Seaborne
features.desc: Advantage on Strength and Dexterity saves and checks to avoid being pushed, knocked Prone, or moved against your will, and on checks to pilot waterborne vehicles.

features.name: Viking Weapon Mastery
features.desc: If you have Weapon Mastery with a Battleaxe, Longsword, or Spear, once on each of your turns add your Proficiency Bonus to a damage roll with it.

features.name: Savage Charge
features.desc: As an Attack action, move up to your Speed and make one melee attack. On a hit, a Bonus Action Dash lets you pass through the target's space without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Call of the Northlands
features.desc: At the end of a Long Rest choose one (replacing the previous): Dragonslayer (Advantage on attacks against Dragons), Hardy Swimmer (Swim Speed equal to Speed), Inured to Cold (Resistance to Cold), or Trollslayer (Advantage on attacks against Giants).

features.name: Marauder's Reprisal
features.desc: When you become Bloodied or take a Critical Hit, use your Reaction to attack an enemy in reach; a hit is a Critical Hit and grants Temporary Hit Points equal to half your level. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Unstoppable Assault
features.desc: As an action once per Long Rest, attack additional times equal to half your Proficiency Bonus beyond your normal attacks; hits from these are Critical Hits and push the target 10 feet unless it succeeds on a Strength save (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Strength modifier).

features.name: Tenets of Valhalla
features.desc: Protect the worthy dead. Inspire courage in battle. Bring justice to those who make a mockery of the dead.

features.name: Encouraging Smite
features.desc: Right after casting Divine Smite, expend a Channel Divinity: creatures of your choice within 30 feet have Advantage on attacks and saves against the target until the start of your next turn, and their attacks against it deal an extra 1d4 Thunder.

features.name: Guardian of the Dead
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, expend a Channel Divinity for 1 hour: within 10 feet of a creature at 0 Hit Points you have Advantage on attacks and on saves against Charmed or Frightened (Immunity to Charmed once you have Aura of Courage). When a creature you can see casts a spell to create Undead or restore life, take a Reaction to move half your Speed and attack it.

features.name: Oath of Valhalla Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Heroism, Searing Smite; 5 Gentle Repose, Shining Smite; 9 Beacon of Hope, Glyph of Warding (Thunder); 13 Aura of Purity, Guardian of Faith; 17 Flame Strike, Hallow.

features.name: Thunderous Aura
features.desc: You and allies in your Aura of Protection have Immunity to Thunder damage. Your Find Steed mount's attacks can deal Thunder damage.

features.name: Valorous Soul
features.desc: When you reduce a foe to 0 Hit Points with a melee attack, allies of your choice within 60 feet have Advantage on attacks and saves for 1 minute. If you die, your body is preserved as by Gentle Repose, and you may refuse to be raised.

features.name: Spirit of the Valkyrie
features.desc: As a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: Fly Speed 60 feet; Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects; creatures in your Aura of Protection that try to create or summon Undead must succeed on a Charisma save or fail; Smite spells cast with any slot act as level 5; and enemies starting their turn in your aura take Thunder damage equal to your Charisma modifier + Proficiency Bonus and must make a Constitution save or be Stunned until the end of their next turn. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a level 5 slot.

features.name: Spirit Caller Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Bane, Bless, Heroism, Protection from Evil and Good; 5 Augury, Healing Spirit; 7 Speak with Dead, Spirit Guardians; 9 Aura of Life, Death Ward.

features.name: Occult Expertise
features.desc: Proficiency in Arcana and Religion, and you can use Charisma instead of Intelligence for them.

features.name: Spirit Guidance
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, give yourself Advantage on a skill check. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Spirit Aura
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, create a 10-foot spirit aura around you or a willing ally for 1 minute. Maddening Whispers: an enemy entering or starting its turn there makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on ability checks and attacks until the end of its next turn. Bolstering Whispers: allies entering or starting there have Advantage on ability checks and attacks until the end of their next turn. Twice per Long Rest, or again for 3 Sorcery Points.

features.name: Spiritual Secrets
features.desc: When you fail an ability check, attack roll, or save, reroll and take the new result. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest; spend 3 Sorcery Points for another.

features.name: Spiritual Storm
features.desc: Your spirit aura extends 15 feet, and enemies entering or starting their turn in it take 2d8 Psychic (once per turn).

features.name: Context Switch
features.desc: When a creature makes a melee attack against you, take a Reaction to swap places with a creature within 5 feet (Wisdom save if unwilling); it becomes the target and takes the damage, and an enemy so targeted has Disadvantage on attacks until the start of your next turn. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Trickster Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Enlarge/Reduce, Magic Mouth, Silent Image; 5 Nondetection, Slow; 7 Compulsion, Confusion; 9 Animate Objects, Modify Memory.

features.name: Nimble Trickery
features.desc: Proficiency in Sleight of Hand, and Advantage on Sleight of Hand checks to swap an item for one of similar size. At level 6 you can swap with an unattended object up to 30 feet away; at level 14 you can replace it with a 1-minute illusion instead. Once per Long Rest, or restore by expending a Pact Magic slot.

features.name: Distant Switch
features.desc: Context Switch can target a creature within 30 feet, or the swapped creature has Disadvantage on its save. If the target fails, you can have the Invisible condition until the end of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage, or cast a spell.

features.name: Painful Unreality
features.desc: You automatically succeed on Study checks to tell if something is illusory. When a creature interacts with your Illusion spell and fails to see through it, you can force a Wisdom save: 4d10 Psychic and Stunned until the end of its next turn, or half damage only.

features.name: Harbinger of Chaos
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, announce changes to reality. Enemies that can see and hear you make an Intelligence save; on a failure they have Disadvantage on d20 tests until the end of their next turn, and you and your allies have Advantage on attacks and d20 tests against them. Once per Short Rest.

features.name: Cat Whisperer
features.desc: You can understand and talk with felines, use any Influence action skill option with them, and have Advantage on those checks.

features.name: Feline Nature
features.desc: Climb Speed equal to your Speed; when you fall while not Incapacitated you land on your feet and subtract up to 20 feet from the fall for damage. Nine Lives: when reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed, immediately use Second Wind (no action) before falling Unconscious.

features.name: Outsized Trickery
features.desc: You can Shove creatures of any size. On a failed save, a pushed target goes 5 feet farther and takes Bludgeoning equal to half your Fighter level (round up) + Strength modifier; a knocked-Prone target takes Bludgeoning equal to half your Fighter level (round up).

features.name: Pouncing Fighting Style
features.desc: This subclass can take the Pouncing Fighting Style feat: after moving 15 feet or more toward a creature, +2 to your next melee or Unarmed Strike attack against it, or +2 to the DC of your Grapple or Shove.

features.name: Evasive Maneuvers
features.desc: Deft Cover: Half Cover while at least two Small or larger enemies are within 5 feet. Nimble Redirect: once per Short or Long Rest, when hit by a weapon or Unarmed Strike, take a Reaction to reduce the damage by your Fighter level and deal that much to a creature or object within 5 feet.

features.name: Vigilant Reflexes
features.desc: You can't be surprised unless Incapacitated. Right after rolling Initiative, take a Reaction to move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and Hide as part of it.

features.name: Cautious Tenacity
features.desc: Two more uses of Second Wind, and using it grants the Dodge action's benefits until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Swatting Flurry
features.desc: Once per turn when you hit with a Melee weapon as part of the Attack action, make up to five more attack rolls against that target with it, stopping at the first miss; each hit deals 1d10 of the weapon's type with no added damage or effects.

features.name: Beyond Coincidence
features.desc: You have Fortune Dice (d20s) equal to half your Rogue level (round up), regained on a Long Rest. Spend one for a Luck check: a Charisma check with Expertise that nothing can modify. Favored Talent: replace any ability check with a Luck check. Lucky Break: as a Magic action, describe a lucky turn of events; the GM sets a DC by likelihood (5 to 9 extremely plausible, up to 30+ nearly impossible) and it happens on a success. Discuss this subclass with your GM first.

features.name: Cup Half Full
features.desc: When you or a creature within 60 feet rolls a 20 on a meaningful D20 Test, regain one Fortune Die.

features.name: Lucky Strike
features.desc: Spend a Fortune Die to make a Luck check in place of an attack roll; a hit triggers Sneak Attack even if it otherwise wouldn't (once per turn). Withdraw on this attack costs no Sneak Attack dice.

features.name: Boon of Fortuity
features.desc: After a Long Rest roll two d20s and record them. Once per turn, before targets roll, replace the DC of a save forced by a creature you can see with one of these rolls. Unused rolls are lost on a Long Rest.

features.name: The Skin of Your Teeth
features.desc: Roll three d20s for Boon of Fortuity. When you or an ally within 60 feet takes 100 damage or less, replace the damage with one of your fortuitous rolls.

features.name: Your Coven
features.desc: Choose a coven: Crowsworn, Cloud Cap Coven, Fish Head Coven, League of the Gilded Gourd, Patchwork Robe Coven, or The Tall Hats. It sets your Coven's Bond and Voice of the Many options.

features.name: Coven Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Animal Friendship, Bless, Borrow Magic, Mirror Image, Shared Vision; 5 Bestow Curse, Clairvoyance; 7 Pacify Monster, Polymorph; 9 Awaken, Telepathic Bond.

features.name: Collective Knowledge
features.desc: Borrowed Talent: once per Long Rest, gain proficiency with a skill or tool you are checking (no action), or learn a language as a Magic action, until your next Long Rest. Spell Swap: once per Long Rest, a 10-minute ritual lets you ask a coven witch one yes/no question and swap a prepared level 1+ Warlock spell for a Druid or Wizard spell of the same or lower level until your next Long Rest, casting it once without a slot.

features.name: Coven's Bond
features.desc: Once per Long Rest as a Bonus Action, bond with a creature within 60 feet for 1 hour, using its effect up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) times. Crowsworn or Fish Head: bond an enemy; when you take damage, halve it and the bound creature takes the same amount. Cloud Cap or Tall Hats: bond a willing creature; when either of you fails a save, the other can make it and lend the result. Gilded Gourd or Patchwork Robe: bond a willing creature; as a Bonus Action teleport to it, bring it to you, or swap places within 60 feet.

features.name: Distant Protections
features.desc: Once per Short or Long Rest, when an enemy deals you 10 or more damage, take a Reaction to regain 1d10 + Charisma modifier Hit Points and gain +5 AC, the Invisible condition, or a Fly Speed equal to your Speed until the end of your next turn. It triggers automatically when you drop to 0 but aren't killed.

features.name: Voice of the Many
features.desc: Once per Long Rest, by coven. Fish Head or Gilded Gourd: as a Magic action, cast a level 6 or lower Druid or Wizard Evocation spell (not a Reaction spell) without a slot or Material components. Cloud Cap or Crowsworn: as a Bonus Action roll three d6 and assign them as bonuses to AC and two saves for 1 minute. Patchwork Robe or Tall Hats: when you or a creature you can see is targeted by a spell of level 6 or lower, take a Reaction to make it also target any other creature you can see.

name: Path of the Lightning Vessel
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

features.name: Galvanic Heart
features.desc: Resistance to Lightning damage (if you already have it, also reduce Lightning damage by d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus). Vessel save DC is 8 + Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Vessel Damage is d4s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, always Lightning.

features.name: Unbound Storm
features.desc: While raging: Electrified Chains (Bonus Action; your next hit this turn deals Vessel Damage and ensnares the target until your next turn, and moving more than 10 feet requires an Athletics check against your DC or it takes Vessel Damage and its Speed drops to 0); Fulgurant Strike (after a melee hit, a Bonus Action calls lightning through your weapon: Vessel Damage to the target and creatures in a 10-foot Emanation that fail a Dexterity save); Lightning Step (Bonus Action move half your Speed, dealing Vessel Damage to one creature within 5 feet where you stop).

features.name: Roaring Crash
features.desc: As part of entering Rage, leap to a space within 30 feet not occupied by a Huge or larger creature; creatures in a 10-foot Emanation make a Dexterity save, twice your Vessel Damage or half. A creature in the landing space has Disadvantage and is pushed 5 feet (or knocked Prone). 60 feet and Huge spaces at level 10; 90 feet and any creature at 14.

features.name: Lightning Reflexes
features.desc: Add your Constitution modifier (minimum +1) to Dexterity checks, including Initiative. While raging, Lightning Step once per turn costs no Bonus Action.

features.name: Electric Beast
features.desc: Add your Constitution modifier to Vessel Damage. Chains trigger on 5 feet of movement and also deny Reactions; Fulgurant Strike's Emanation is 20 feet and spares up to your Constitution modifier creatures; Lightning Step moves your full Speed and can teleport.

name: Circle of Symbiosis
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

features.name: Circle of Symbiosis Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Arm Cannon, Calcified Memories, Fractured Shell, Phalangeal Shot, Shillelagh; 5 Displacing Maw, Osseous Impalement; 7 Dread Scarecrow, Maiden of Bones; 9 Forest of Dread, Tree Stride.

features.name: Grafted Powers
features.desc: Choose one: Bear Back (count one size larger for carrying and grappling, and add Wisdom to Strength checks), Deer Head (Advantage on Perception), or Goat Hooves (Advantage against Prone and a Climb Speed equal to your Speed).

features.name: Wickerbone Behemoth
features.desc: As a Bonus Action without armor or Shield, spend a Wild Shape use to become a behemoth for 10 minutes: your arms are Shillelagh Clubs whose mastery you can use, you are under Barkskin without Concentration, creatures of your choice within 5 feet take 1d4 Piercing when they damage you with an attack (2d4 at level 10), and at the start of each turn you regain half the damage taken since your last turn (up to five times your Proficiency Bonus).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.desc: Attack twice when you take the Attack action, and you can replace one attack with a cantrip.

features.name: Nature's Wrath
features.desc: You are permanently under Barkskin. While a behemoth you are Large, and taking the Attack action gives Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing until the end of your next turn (lost early if you take Fire damage).

features.name: Briarheart
features.desc: While a behemoth your arms also use the Nick mastery, and after taking the Attack action you can cast an action-time Osteomancy spell as a Bonus Action.

name: Blood Hound
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

features.name: Blood Strike
features.desc: Learn three Blood Strike options (one more at levels 5, 9, 13, and 17; swap one each time). Once per turn on an Attack action weapon attack, apply one; you take its Blood Cost in unpreventable Necrotic damage. Uses equal to 1 + Constitution modifier per Short or Long Rest; save DC 8 + Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Options: Bewitching (1d8: +2d6 Psychic and Wisdom save or it treats an ally as an enemy), Bloodboil (1d6: 2d6 Fire ignoring Resistance in a 10-foot Emanation and burning), Bloodshard (1d8: a 60-foot Line, Dexterity save for weapon damage +1d6 Piercing or half), Constraining (1d8: +2d6 Acid, Disadvantage on its next attack, and a Dexterity save or 2d6 Acid when it moves), Exiling (1d10: Charisma save or banished until the end of its next turn), Hunting (1d4: ignores AC from armor, Shields, and magic; +1d6 Slashing and you track it for a minute), Shadowblood (1d6: +2d6 Necrotic and magical Darkness in 10 feet), Thunderblood (1d4: +2d6 Thunder, pushed 15 feet, Strength save or Prone), Withering (1d6: +2d6 Necrotic and Constitution save or its damage is halved). Damage dice improve at level 18.

features.name: Blood Hound Anatomy
features.desc: Immune to magical contagions, Resistance to Poison damage, and Advantage on saves against Poisoned. Advantage on Investigation, Perception, and Survival checks to find a creature with blood that you have damaged.

features.name: Blood Armament
features.desc: Your wielded weapon is blood-coated and can deal Acid, Necrotic, or Poison damage instead of its normal type.

features.name: Blood Explosion
features.desc: When you miss with a blood-coated weapon, a Bonus Action detonates it: the target and others in a 5-foot Emanation make a Constitution save, taking weapon damage or half.

features.name: Blood of Creation
features.desc: Reroll a Blood Cost and take the lower result, and swap one Blood Strike option after each Long Rest.

features.name: Blood Symphony
features.desc: Using a Blood Strike heals you by your Constitution modifier (minimum 1), and a target that dies within 1 minute of a Blood Strike restores a use.

features.name: Improved Blood Strike
features.desc: Your Blood Strike options deal more damage, as noted in each option.

name: Oath of the Eldritch Hunt
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

features.name: Tenets of the Eldritch Hunt
features.desc: Resolve, Respect, Responsibility.

features.name: Hunt the Prey
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, spend a Channel Divinity to mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute; then and as a Bonus Action on later turns, teleport up to 60 feet to a space within 5 feet of it while you can see it. If it drops to 0, move the mark to another creature within 60 feet.

features.name: Oath of the Eldritch Hunt Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Faerie Fire, Spectral Slash; 5 Hold Person, Moonbeam; 9 Displacing Maw, Spectral Fury; 13 Evard's Black Tentacles, Maiden of Bones; 17 Contact Other Plane, Hold Monster.

features.name: Stolen Eldritch Gift
features.desc: Add your Charisma modifier to Athletics, Perception, and Survival checks.

features.name: Sharpened Senses
features.desc: You learn the Immunities, Resistances, and Vulnerabilities of creatures in your Aura of Protection, and have Blindsight within its range.

features.name: Relentless Pursuit
features.desc: When you hit your marked target with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike right after teleporting with Hunt the Prey, cast Divine Smite without a Bonus Action (once per turn).

features.name: Perfect Hunter
features.desc: As a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: weapon attacks deal +1d8 Necrotic ignoring Resistance and Immunity; Immunity to Grappled, Paralyzed, and Restrained; and the Invisible condition. Once per Long Rest, or restore with a level 5 slot.

name: Torturer Conclave
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.desc: Proficiency and Expertise with Torture Tools and Insight. An hour with the tools on a Restrained creature inflicts Exhaustion (and possibly 10 damage on a failed Dexterity check against 20 minus its Constitution modifier), and Intimidation against a creature you've used them on gets +twice your Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Torturer Techniques
features.desc: With Torture Tools at hand, add one technique to a melee or Unarmed Strike hit once per turn; each technique twice per Long Rest (spend a Favored Enemy use to restore one). Empower by expending a slot (level 1 at Ranger 3 up to level 5 at 17) for extra damage of Wisdom modifier times slot level and -1d4 per slot level on the target's save. Save DC 8 + Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Combing (+1d10 Slashing; from level 7, two rounds running causes decay), Enucleation (+1d6 and Constitution save or Disadvantage on Perception and Blinded beyond 60 feet), Hamstringing (+1d6 Slashing and Constitution save or Speed 0 until your next turn), Nerve Scraping (+1d4 Psychic and Constitution save or it must attack a random creature), Throat Chop (+1d8 Bludgeoning and it can't speak or cast verbal spells; from level 11, two rounds running can Stun), Tympanic Rupture (+1d8 Bludgeoning and Constitution save or Deafened for 1 minute).

features.name: Depraved Mind
features.desc: Immunity to Frightened and Resistance to Psychic. A creature trying to read or speak into your mind against your will must succeed on a Wisdom save or take Psychic damage equal to your level and fail.

features.name: Veil of Pain
features.desc: When a technique damages a creature, it makes a Wisdom save or you are Invisible to it for 1 minute (save each turn). Wisdom modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Mental Agony
features.desc: When a creature within 60 feet that failed a save against your technique since your last turn makes an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma save, take a Reaction to make it subtract 1d10 (not against Fright-immune creatures).

name: Blade of Radiance
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

features.name: Sanctified Champion
features.desc: Proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor. After a Short Rest, sanctify a Piercing or Slashing melee weapon: it has Finesse for you and ignores Resistance of Aberrations, Fiends, and Undead.

features.name: Divine Blessings
features.desc: Divine Points equal to 1 + Wisdom modifier per Short or Long Rest, and regain one when your sanctified blade kills an Aberration, Beast, Fiend, or Undead of CR 1/2+. Save DC 8 + Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Armor of the Faithful (Reaction, 1: the attacker makes a Wisdom save or must retarget and can't target you until your next turn); Divine Inspiration (1: reroll a History, Religion, or Insight check and add your Wisdom modifier); Rend the Blasphemous (Bonus Action after attacking, 1: another blade attack adding your Wisdom modifier to hit).

features.name: Righteous Armament
features.desc: Chains of Judgement (1 on a hit: Strength save or Radiant equal to Wisdom modifier and Restrained until the end of your next turn); Divine Retaliation (Reaction, 1: when hit in melee, attack back adding your Wisdom modifier to damage); Erupting Blades (2, forgoing Sneak Attack: a 45-foot Line takes your Sneak Attack damage as Radiant, Dexterity save for half).

features.name: Saintly Revelations
features.desc: Learn two Cleric cantrips. Heroism, Protection from Evil and Good, and Shield of Faith are always prepared and castable at will on yourself without slots or components (Wisdom); from level 17 they need no Concentration but only one is active at a time.

features.name: Final Judgement
features.desc: Divine Spirits: once per Long Rest (or 3 Divine Points), cast Spirit Guardians without a slot; creatures in it count as next to an ally for Sneak Attack. Radiant Blade: on command your blade sheds light 30 feet, counts as magic, and deals +2d4 Radiant.

name: Osteomancer
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

features.name: Brittle Bone Armor
features.desc: As an action without armor or Shield, gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wizard level for 1 hour; while they last you have Resistance to Piercing and Slashing and +2 AC. Once per Long Rest, or restore with a level 2+ slot.

features.name: Anatomical Expert
features.desc: Proficiency in Medicine; add your Intelligence modifier to Medicine and Survival checks, with Expertise when they concern a creature with a skeleton.

features.name: Bone Puppetry
features.desc: As a Magic action, a creature with a skeleton within 60 feet makes a Strength save or you control its actions until the end of its next turn (it attacks allies with Disadvantage and they have Advantage on saves against it). One at a time; Intelligence modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Skeletal Mastery
features.desc: Cast Alter Self without a slot or Concentration (Change Appearance or Natural Weapons only). As a Magic action dissolve or restore your skeleton: boneless you have Speed 10, squeeze through 1-inch gaps, count as Prone, and can't use hands, attack, or cast (a Bonus Action regrows hand bones until your next turn).

features.name: Improved Bone Puppetry
features.desc: Control lasts 1 minute with full obedience (save each turn), requiring Concentration that damage can't break; spend another use to impose Disadvantage on its save.

features.name: Instinctual Divination
features.desc: When you take the Study action to make an Arcana or Religion check, you can make it as a Wisdom (Survival) check instead.

features.name: Spell Hammer
features.desc: Once per turn while raging, deal double your Rage Damage bonus with a Strength-based hit, or triple against a target that has Legendary Actions, can cast spells, or was summoned.

features.name: Spell Shield
features.desc: While raging, you and allies in a 30-foot Emanation add your Rage Damage bonus to saves against spells.

features.name: Sunder the Weave
features.desc: Counterspell is always prepared; once per Short or Long Rest while raging cast it without a slot or components (Strength), and as part of that Reaction move up to your Speed and make one weapon attack against the caster.

features.name: Bolstering Howl
features.desc: When you or a creature that can hear you takes damage, take a Reaction to give it Resistance to that damage and that type until the end of the turn.

features.name: Dimensional Duel
features.desc: Banishment is always prepared. When you rage or as a Bonus Action while raging, cast it without a slot or components (Strength) on up to three creatures, maintaining Concentration while raging, and you can follow them into a lit demiplane of 30 to 200 feet where they aren't Incapacitated. Strength modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Tragic Hero
features.desc: When you fail a save, other creatures you choose within 60 feet add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to their saves against the same effect.

features.name: One Life, Many Roles
features.desc: Once per Short or Long Rest as a Bonus Action, cast Disguise Self; copying a creature you can see also copies its mannerisms and voice.

features.name: Stage Direction
features.desc: When a creature that can see you would roll your Bardic Inspiration die, it uses the die's maximum instead. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Assemble the Troupe
features.desc: Your One Life, Many Roles Disguise Self can also disguise up to six willing creatures within 30 feet as you choose, and disguised creatures add your Charisma modifier to Charisma checks.

features.name: Grand Finale
features.desc: Once per Long Rest as a Magic action, up to two other creatures within 60 feet that see or hear you can immediately take an action.

features.name: Apocalypse Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Darkness, Hellish Rebuke, Phantasmal Force, Thunderwave; 5 Doom, Fear; 7 Blight, Ice Storm; 9 Antilife Shell, Insect Plague.

features.name: Visions of Annihilation
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, attacks against a creature you can see within 120 feet have Advantage until the start of your next turn. Wisdom modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Doom Song
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, spend a Channel Divinity: for 10 minutes attacks against a creature you can see within 120 feet crit on 19 or 20.

features.name: All Will Be Dust
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, spend a Channel Divinity: a creature you can see within 120 feet has Disadvantage on its next save against your spells before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Life Beyond Death
features.desc: When you or an ally within 120 feet is about to make a Death Saving Throw, expend a spell slot (no action) to heal it ten times the slot level.

features.name: Circle of the Symbiote Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Barkskin, Entangle, Guidance; 5 Plant Growth; 7 Hallucinatory Terrain; 9 Tree Stride.

features.name: Primal Symbiote
features.desc: Advantage on Constitution saves to maintain Concentration. Symbiotic Transformation: as a Bonus Action, spend a Wild Shape use for 1 minute of +2 AC, Temporary Hit Points of 2 + half your Druid level at the start of each turn, and Advantage on Stealth.

features.name: Symbiotic Reflexes
features.desc: Haste is always prepared, and once per Symbiotic Transformation you can cast it on yourself without a slot or components.

features.name: Survival Instinct
features.desc: While Incapacitated you can still Dash, Disengage, or Dodge, and keep the Dodge benefits while Incapacitated.

features.name: Surge of Sustenance
features.desc: Once per Long Rest as a Magic action, spend a Wild Shape use to give yourself or a creature you touch the benefits of a Short Rest.

features.name: Bolstering Presence
features.desc: At the start of your turn (no action), creatures of your choice within 30 feet that see or hear you regain 2d6 + half your Fighter level Hit Points. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Heroic Effort
features.desc: At the end of a creature's turn, take a Reaction to move your Speed and make one attack; then an ally within 30 feet can use its Reaction to do the same. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Lead by Example
features.desc: Heroic Effort ends Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned on you and on the ally you choose.

features.name: Inspiring Presence
features.desc: Creatures you bolster add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to D20 Tests and damage rolls until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Durable Presence
features.desc: Bolstering Presence recharges on a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Mighty Effort
features.desc: Heroic Effort can include up to three allies.

features.name: Guardian of the Way Technique
features.desc: Once per turn when a Flurry of Blows Unarmed Strike deals damage: Anchoring Strike (the target can't teleport or travel between planes until the end of your next turn) or Banishing Strike (teleport the target up to 15 feet to a space you can see).

features.name: Seeker
features.desc: Detect Magic and Comprehend Languages are always prepared; once per Long Rest (or for 1 Focus Point) cast one without a slot or components (Wisdom).

features.name: Warden of Harmony
features.desc: When a creature within 60 feet tries to teleport, take a Reaction and spend 1 Focus Point to stop it.

features.name: Cosmic Restoration
features.desc: Once per Long Rest (or for 4 Focus Points), as a Bonus Action touch a willing creature to end spells of your choice on it, or remove Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned, or one Exhaustion level.

features.name: Ward the Profane
features.desc: Once per turn on an Unarmed Strike hit, spend 3 Focus Points to cast Banishment on the target (Wisdom).

features.name: Tenets of the Guardian
features.desc: Choose up to four ideals matching your alignment, such as Courage, Sacrifice, Service, Fidelity, Protection, Affinity, Beauty, Freedom, Dominance, Opportunism, or Profit.

features.name: Oath of the Guardian Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Alarm, Shield of Faith; 5 Lesser Restoration, Warding Bond; 9 Beacon of Hope, Protection from Energy; 13 Death Ward, Guardian of Faith; 17 Greater Restoration, Raise Dead.

features.name: Defensive Intervention
features.desc: When a creature you can see hits another creature within 30 feet with an attack roll, take a Reaction and spend a Channel Divinity to teleport up to 30 feet into range and become the target.

features.name: Marking Strike
features.desc: When you hit with a weapon, forgo its mastery to mark the target until the end of your next turn: it has Disadvantage on attacks against others and spends 2 feet per foot moving away from you.

features.name: Guarding Presence
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, up to your Charisma modifier creatures within 5 feet use your AC while they stay within 5 feet.

features.name: Inspiring Defense
features.desc: You and creatures under your Guarding Presence make two attacks with each Opportunity Attack.

features.name: Ward of the Guardian
features.desc: When a creature you've marked drops an ally to 0 without killing it, take a Reaction to leave the ally at 1 Hit Point, and it can use its Reaction to make a melee attack against the marked creature. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Guardian Angel
features.desc: Once per Long Rest (or with a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 1 minute: Guarding Presence becomes a 100-foot Emanation, you regain a Channel Divinity on any turn you have none, and once per round use Ward of the Guardian without a Reaction.

features.name: Trail Warden Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Goodberry; 5 Pass Without Trace; 9 Spirit Guardians; 13 Guardian of Faith; 17 Mass Cure Wounds.

features.name: Coordinated Tactics
features.desc: Roll your Teamwork Die (d6; d8 at level 11, d10 at 17) at the start of each turn. Coordinated Strikes: when another creature you can see hits, take a Reaction to add the die to the damage. Coordinated Tactics: after rolling, willing creatures within 60 feet that see you can use their Reactions to move up to five times the roll (or their Speed) without provoking or Difficult Terrain.

features.name: Lead the Way
features.desc: When you succeed on a check with a skill you have Expertise in, chosen creatures within 60 feet add your Teamwork Die to the same check until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Tactical Assault
features.desc: Allies you move with Coordinated Tactics also gain one: Guardian Maneuver (reduce the first damage they take by the Teamwork Die) or Recon Maneuver (Hide as part of the move, adding the die to Stealth).

features.name: Coordinated Effort
features.desc: When you roll Initiative and aren't Incapacitated, roll the Teamwork Die; you and allies within 30 feet that see or hear you add it to Initiative.

features.name: Group Assault
features.desc: When all your attacks in an Attack action target one creature, chosen creatures within 60 feet add your Teamwork Die to one attack and damage roll against it.

features.name: Shadowy Reflection
features.desc: As a Magic action, detach your shadow into a space within 5 feet; later control it as a Magic action or with your Cunning Action, moving it your Speed to manipulate objects, open unlocked doors, or carry up to 10 pounds. It can't attack and vanishes if damaged, targeted, or you are Incapacitated.

features.name: Shadow Motes
features.desc: You have Shadow Motes equal to your Rogue level per Long Rest, regaining one when you drop a hostile creature to 0. Shadow Scout (1: as a Magic action, see and hear through your shadow for 1 minute up to 120 feet away); Shadow Swap (1, with Cunning Action: swap places with your shadow); Vexing Shadow (1, after a weapon hit with your shadow within 5 feet of the target: you are Invisible to it until the end of your next turn).

features.name: Shadowed Succor
features.desc: Once per Long Rest, Uncanny Dodge reduces the damage to 0.

features.name: Shadow Gate
features.desc: As a Bonus Action with your shadow within 5 feet, spend 4 Shadow Motes to cast Dimension Door (Intelligence); your shadow travels too.

features.name: True Shadow
features.desc: Once per Long Rest as a Bonus Action, your shadow becomes a substantial duplicate for 1 hour that can Attack, Hide, or Utilize using your statistics when you control it, and your attacks against creatures within 5 feet of it have Advantage.

features.name: Innate Darkness Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Confounding Shadows, Darkness, Tide of Darkness, Umbral Tendril; 5 Fear, Shadowy Eruption; 7 Black Tentacles, Greater Invisibility; 9 Mislead, Summon Shadow.

features.name: Shadowed Soul
features.desc: Darkvision 60 feet (or +60 feet), and you can see through magical Darkness you create with your Innate Darkness spells unless Blinded or Incapacitated.

features.name: Friends to Darkness
features.desc: When you cast an Innate Darkness spell, up to your Charisma modifier creatures can see through your magical Darkness for 1 minute.

features.name: Pure Darkness
features.desc: Darkvision and Blindsight can't see into Darkness created by your Innate Darkness spells.

features.name: One with Darkness
features.desc: On your turn you are Invisible, even to Truesight and Blindsight, and if you haven't moved you can teleport up to 30 feet to a space you can see (then your Speed is 0 for the turn).

name: Exalted Assembly of the Feline Court

features.name: Feline Spells
features.desc: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Animal Friendship, Cat's Spring, Feather Fall, Feline Grace, Misty Step, Speak with Animals; 5 Haste, Phantom Panther; 7 Freedom of Movement, Dimension Door; 9 Feline Chaos, Telekinesis.

features.name: Feline Affinity
features.desc: Cast Speak with Animals without a slot, but only to talk with cats.

features.name: Feline Form
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, become a Cat for hours equal to half your Warlock level, keeping your Hit Points, mental scores, class features, languages, feats, and proficiencies. You can cast only Feline Spells (without Material components), and casting a non-hostile spell while Hidden keeps you Invisible. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Vexing Distraction
features.desc: In cat form, as a Bonus Action a creature within 5 feet that can see and hear you makes a Wisdom save or you choose: Annoy (Disadvantage on D20 Tests), Confound (Speed 0), or Distract (a creature you choose has Total Cover from it) until the end of your next turn. Charisma modifier uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Nine Lives
features.desc: You have nine lives per Long Rest: spend 1 to avoid a death save failure from damage at 0 (2 for a critical), 1 to succeed on a death save, 5 to turn it into a 20, 1 to survive massive damage at 0, 1 to drop to 1 instead of 0, or 9 to ignore an instant-death effect.

features.name: Summon the Courtiers
features.desc: When a creature within 60 feet damages you, take a Reaction: spectral cats deal it 5d10 Force and leave it Blinded and Prone until the end of your next turn. Once per Long Rest, or restore with a Pact Magic slot.

features.name: Book Learning
features.desc: Touching a text for 1 minute grants a working knowledge of it unless coded. For a magic book or script, you learn its properties, attunement, charges, active spells, and the spell that made it.

features.name: Edit Spell
features.desc: Choose a level 1+ spell in your spellbook; prepared versions can gain +1 save DC, a different damage type, and/or an Intelligence save instead of the normal one, and can be prepared multiple times with different edits (each counts as prepared). Change the choice after a Long Rest.

features.name: Weaver of Words
features.desc: You learn all languages available in the campaign.

features.name: Customized Spell
features.desc: Choose a level 1+ Concentration spell with a Verbal component and name a willing creature other than you when you prepare it; cast on that creature alone, it needs no Concentration.

features.name: Master of Words
features.desc: When you prepare spells, link two level 1 to 5 one-action Verbal spells into one prepared spell of their combined level (maximum 6); casting it as a Magic action produces both effects.

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.desc: Proficiency with Smith's Tools (or another Artisan's Tool if you already have it). Crafting an ordinary or magic weapon takes half the time.

features.name: Forge Adept Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: Armor of Agathys, Shield of Faith (3); Spiritual Weapon, Warding Bond (5); Beacon of Hope, Remove Curse (9); Death Ward, Fire Shield (13); Banishing Smite, Wall of Force (17).

features.name: Battle Ready
features.desc: Use Intelligence for attack and damage rolls with magic weapons. Proficiency with Martial weapons, and you can use a weapon you're proficient with as your Artificer spellcasting focus.

features.name: Ghaal'Shaarat
features.desc: As a Magic action with Smith's Tools in hand, imbue a Simple or Martial melee weapon with your spirit until you imbue another or die. While you wield it, it is magic with a +1 bonus to attack and damage, has the Thrown property (30/120), and returns to your hand after a ranged attack.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.desc: You attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Runes of War
features.desc: Your Ghaal'Shaarat bonus becomes +2. Aura of War: as a Magic action, a 30-foot Emanation for 1 minute; you and allies in it deal an extra 1d4 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (your choice) on weapon or Unarmed Strike hits. Uses equal to your Intelligence modifier per Long Rest.

features.name: Perfect Weapon
features.desc: Your Ghaal'Shaarat bonus becomes +3, and on your first attack each turn you can shift some or all of it to your AC until your next turn. Hits deal an extra 1d6 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder (and can deal that type instead of the normal one). Resistance to Psychic, and immunity to Charmed and Frightened.

features.name: Weapon of Legend (variant capstone)
features.desc: With DM permission, replaces Soul of Artifice. While wielding your Ghaal'Shaarat: Aura of War is always active (Bonus Action to change its type); enemies starting their turn in it take its extra damage; as a Bonus Action raise the aura to 2d6 for 1 minute, Intelligence modifier times per Long Rest.

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.desc: Proficiency with Tinker's Tools (or another Artisan's Tool if you already have it). Crafting a magic item takes half the time.

features.name: Maverick Spells
features.desc: Learn one cantrip from the Artificer, Cleric, or Wizard list. When you prepare spells, prepare extra spells equal to your Proficiency Bonus from the Artificer, Cleric, or Wizard lists; all count as Artificer spells.

features.name: Arcane Prototype
features.desc: At the end of a Long Rest with Tinker's Tools, spend Arcane Charges (spell level each) to build prototypes holding spells from the Artificer, Cleric, or Wizard lists. Only you can cast from them, without a slot, preparation, or material components; a prototype crumbles after use unless you expend a slot of the spell's level. Prototypes/max level/charges: 1/1/1 at 3, 2/2/3 at 5, 3/3/5 at 9, 3/4/7 at 13, 4/5/9 at 15, 4/6/11 at 17, 5/6/13 at 20.

features.name: Fine Tuning
features.desc: With Tinker's Tools on you, add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of an Artificer spell.

features.name: Work in Progress
features.desc: After a Short Rest, swap one prepared spell for another from the Artificer, Cleric, or Wizard list.

features.name: Final Breakthrough
features.desc: After a Short Rest, swap a prototype's spell for another of the same level from those lists. You ignore class, species, spell, and level requirements for attuning to or using magic items.

features.name: Improved Genius (variant capstone)
features.desc: With DM permission, replaces Soul of Artifice. Once per Long Rest as a Magic action, cast any spell of level 8 or lower, ignoring its casting time, components, and requirements.

features.name: Broad Inspiration
features.desc: Learn Guidance (doesn't count against cantrips). When you give Bardic Inspiration, you can give the same die to a second creature in range.

features.name: Keeper of History
features.desc: Proficiency in History and Performance, or Expertise in either you already have.

features.name: Commanding Voice
features.desc: When you take the Attack or Magic action, two creatures holding your Bardic Inspiration can spend it to use their Reaction for one weapon attack or Unarmed Strike, adding the die to damage on a hit.

features.name: Battle Hymn
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, sing until the start of your next turn (heard within 60 feet); allies within 30 feet who hear you add 1d4 to ability checks and saving throws.

features.name: Mind Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: Command, Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Mind Spike (3); Clairvoyance, Fear (5); Confusion, Phantasmal Killer (7); Synaptic Static, Telekinesis (9).

features.name: Psychic Feedback
features.desc: When a creature within 30 feet that you can see succeeds on a Wisdom save, use your Reaction and a Channel Divinity to impose Disadvantage on that save.

features.name: Psychic Force
features.desc: Cleric spells that deal Radiant can deal Psychic instead, and spells that deal Psychic add your Charisma modifier to damage against one target.

features.name: Gestalt Anchor
