features.desc: You and allies in a 10-foot Emanation gain +2 to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves (inactive while you're Incapacitated; only one Gestalt Anchor applies at a time).

features.name: Bend Reality
features.desc: Once per Short or Long Rest, when an ally within 30 feet that you can see fails a save, change the roll to a 20.

features.name: Skin of Steel
features.desc: In Wild Shape: max CR equals Druid level / 3; AC is 15 + Wisdom modifier if higher; Resistance to Poison and Advantage on saves against Poisoned; no Exhaustion from hunger, thirst, or suffocation, no need to sleep, and immune to magical sleep. Your form is obviously warforged-like.

features.name: Circle of the Forged Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: Blade Ward, Identify, Mirror Image (3); Haste (5); Fire Shield (7); Animate Objects (9).

features.name: Elementally Imbued
features.desc: Wild Shape attacks can deal Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning. Once per turn on a hit, expend a slot for +1d6 per slot level (max 5d6) of a chosen type; Constitution save or a 1-minute effect (save ends each turn): Acid lowers AC by half your Wisdom modifier, Cold sets Speed to 0 with Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks, Fire deals Wisdom-modifier damage each turn, Lightning blocks Opportunity Attacks and gives Disadvantage on its first attack each turn.

features.name: Adamantine Hide
features.desc: In Wild Shape, Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing. When hit by an attack or forced to save, use your Reaction and a Wild Shape use to shift into a form.

features.name: Construction Perfection
features.desc: In Wild Shape, AC is 16 + Wisdom modifier if higher, and you are immune to Poison damage and to Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned.

features.name: Martial Form
features.desc: At the start of your turn, spend 1 Focus Point to adopt a form for 10 minutes: Forged Heart (Unarmed Strikes crit objects; Flurry hits force a Strength save or push 15 feet), Nightmare Shroud (Deflect Attacks forces a Wisdom save or the attacker is Frightened until the end of its next turn), Traveler's Blade (+10 feet reach), or Weretouched (dropping an adjacent enemy to 0 grants temp HP of a Martial Arts die + Monk level).

features.name: Mutable Strike
features.desc: Your Unarmed Strikes can deal Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage.

features.name: Manifest Blow
features.desc: Gain one: Forged Heart (once per turn, +1 Martial Arts die damage), Nightmare Shroud (Magic action, 2 Focus Points: 30-foot Emanation, Wisdom save or 3 Martial Arts dice Psychic and Frightened, half on success), Traveler's Blade (once per turn deal damage and grapple on one hit; you always count as having a free hand to grapple), or Weretouched (hit the same creature twice in a turn to spend up to 3 Focus Points for that many extra Martial Arts dice).

features.name: Reflexive Adaptation
features.desc: Self-Restoration can also end Blinded, Deafened, and Grappled. A Short Rest removes 1 Exhaustion level, a Long Rest removes all.

features.name: Perfect Form
features.desc: When adopting your Martial Form, spend 3 more Focus Points to also gain Advantage on Flurry of Blows attacks, regain a Martial Arts die of HP at the start of each turn, and +2 AC while in the form.

features.name: Demontongue
features.desc: You speak and understand Abyssal or Infernal (your choice).

features.name: Fiendish Punishment
features.desc: While raging, once per turn when a creature you can see within 60 feet damages you, it takes 1d4 Fire or Necrotic. When an ally within 10 feet is damaged by such a creature, use your Reaction to deal the same. Damage grows to 1d6 (6), 1d8 (10), 1d10 (14), 1d12 (20).

features.name: Just One Master
features.desc: While raging, Advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened and Resistance to Psychic. When you take Psychic damage or save against Charmed or Frightened, you must use your Reaction to Rage without expending a use.

features.name: Overflowing Malice
features.desc: When a creature triggers Fiendish Punishment, all other creatures within 10 feet of you also take the damage.

features.name: Aspect of Tyranny
features.desc: When Fiendish Punishment or Overflowing Malice deals damage, use your Reaction to force one affected creature to make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Con + PB, -1 per other creature affected that turn): on a failure, 1d10 Necrotic and Frightened for 1 minute (save ends each turn).

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.desc: Learn one Sorcerer cantrip (it counts as a Bard cantrip but not against your known cantrips), and you can use a Wand, Rod, or Orb as your Bard focus.

features.name: Wandslinger's Presence
features.desc: After talking with a creature for 1 minute, if it rolls Initiative equal to or higher than yours it makes a Wisdom save; on a failure its Initiative drops to act right after you.

features.name: At Your Fingertips
features.desc: Once per round on your turn, when a Bard cantrip hits or a target fails its save, spend a Bardic Inspiration for +2d6 damage (3d6 at 5, 5d6 at 10, 8d6 at 15).

features.name: Got Your Back
features.desc: When you use At Your Fingertips, use a Bonus Action that turn to give a creature within 60 feet Advantage on its next save within 1 minute.

features.name: Ain't Big Enough for the Both of Us
features.desc: Whenever you spend Bardic Inspiration or a creature within 60 feet adds your die to a D20 Test, one creature within 60 feet that can see you makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened until the end of its next turn; an already Frightened target must use its Reaction to flee.

features.name: Commerce Domain Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: Augury, Charm Person, Comprehend Languages, Locate Object (3); Glyph of Warding, Tongues (5); Divination, Leomund's Secret Chest (7); Legend Lore, Rary's Telepathic Bond (9).

features.name: Divine Wealth
features.desc: After a Long Rest, conjure 2 divine coins (3 at 5, 4 at 9, 5 at 13, 6 at 17), losing unspent ones. Before a save against a hostile effect, spend a coin to add 1d4, or gain a coin by subtracting 1d4.

features.name: Money Spinner
features.desc: Magic action and a Channel Divinity: target one creature within 30 feet plus one per coin spent. Each makes a Wisdom save; on a failure, Reward (Charmed and Friendly for 1 minute or until damaged) or Bribe (Blinded for 1 minute or until damaged), your choice per target.

features.name: Divine Bargain
features.desc: As a Bonus Action with a creature within 30 feet: Buy (give it a coin; it takes 1d8 Necrotic and you or a creature within 30 feet heals that much; it can spend the coin) or Sell (gain a coin; you take unreducible 1d8 Necrotic and it heals that much).

features.name: Open Market
features.desc: Divine Bargain uses 2d8, and you can bargain with up to six creatures at once using one roll, once per Short Rest.

features.name: Bloodhound Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: Alarm (3), Hold Person (5), Clairvoyance (9), Locate Creature (13), Scrying (17).

features.name: Ley Line Tracker
features.desc: After a rest, mark a creature you've seen (or whose possession you hold) as your bounty; once per turn switch it to a creature you can see. Your Ranger Divination spells can target your bounty at any distance on the same plane unless it's warded.

features.name: Unwavering Attention
features.desc: Once per turn, +1d6 damage when you hit your bounty or your Hunter's Mark target. If dealt with an Opportunity Attack, your Reaction returns at the start of the next creature's turn.

features.name: Relentless Pursuit
features.desc: When your bounty or Hunter's Mark target ends its turn more than 5 feet away and you can see it, use your Reaction to move your Speed toward it without provoking.

features.name: Eyes on the Prize
features.desc: When all your Attack-action attacks target one creature, make one extra attack; a melee hit leaves it Grappled or Prone, a ranged hit knocks it Prone.

features.name: Nowhere to Hide
features.desc: Once per Short or Long Rest, cast True Seeing on yourself without a slot or components. Ley Line Tracker ignores magic that hides your bounty from Divination.

features.name: Nemesis Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: Compelled Duel, Mirror Image, See Invisibility, Shield (3); Counterspell, Slow (5); Fire Shield, Otiluke's Resilient Sphere (7); Circle of Power, Mislead (9).

features.name: Readied Magic
features.desc: When you Ready a spell, you have Advantage on saves and ability checks until your next turn and can cast it without your Reaction. If you don't release it, regain Sorcery Points equal to its level at the start of your next turn.

features.name: Spell Deflection
features.desc: When a spell or magical effect damages you, use your Reaction to halve that damage.

features.name: Always Ready
features.desc: Ready a spell as a Bonus Action (it doesn't count toward the one-slot-per-turn limit). Once per Short or Long Rest, or spend 4 Sorcery Points to restore it.

features.name: Mindset of Perfect Prediction
features.desc: Once per Long Rest when you roll Initiative: your Initiative becomes 31, you can concentrate on any number of spells (one save for all), and you can cast Counterspell as a level 6 spell without a slot. At the end of each of your turns, make a Charisma save (DC 8 + Cha + PB) or the mindset ends, keeping one concentration spell.

features.name: Eternity in Stone
features.desc: Once per Short or Long Rest, when you reduce a creature to 0 HP, you can Petrify it and gain 1d10 + Warlock level Temporary Hit Points.

features.name: Stone Speaker
features.desc: Once per Long Rest as a Magic action, question stones in a 30-foot Emanation about the past day, and speak with earth Elementals or Petrified creatures there.

features.name: Stone Sovereign Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: Absorb Elements, Earthbind, Earth Tremor, Spike Growth (3); Magic Circle, Slow (5); Stone Shape, Stoneskin (7); Bigby's Hand, Wall of Stone (9).

features.name: Form of Stone
features.desc: While Petrified you stay aware and are immune to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing. Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Reaction to damage, Petrify yourself until your next turn (before the damage), then emerge from stone up to 30 feet away.

features.name: Stone's Embrace
features.desc: Meld into Stone is always prepared and can include up to five willing creatures within 5 feet. Resting while melded grants Resistance to the first damage after leaving.

features.name: Stone Servant
features.desc: Touch a Petrified creature to make it an Earth Elemental Spirit under your control as a level 6 Summon Elemental, without Concentration, until Greater Restoration, 0 HP, or you use this again.

features.name: Ranged Specialist
features.desc: Training with all ranged weapons (including thrown weapons and firearms), and no Disadvantage on ranged attacks for an enemy within 5 feet.

features.name: Game Hunter
features.desc: After a Long Rest pick Large, Huge, or Gargantuan: ranged hits deal +1d8 Piercing against that size and +1d4 against the other two, up to twice per turn.

features.name: Bolas
features.desc: After a Long Rest make bolas ammunition equal to your Wisdom modifier (damage optional). A hit forces a Strength or Dexterity save (DC 8 + Wis + PB) or the target is Grappled. Leftovers become normal ammunition.

features.name: Special Shots
features.desc: Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest, before a ranged attack roll: Drill Shot (+5 to hit), Trick Shot (measure line of sight and range from a point within 60 feet), or Power Shot (weapon damage and crit dice are maximized).

features.name: Improved Bolas
features.desc: Make bolas equal to Wisdom + Dexterity modifiers, and double your Proficiency Bonus in their DC.

features.name: Reliable Aim
features.desc: Once per turn, reroll a missed ranged weapon attack, Dexterity modifier times per Long Rest (minimum once).

features.name: Improved Special Shots
features.desc: Special Shots uses become twice your Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Apex Hunter
features.desc: Hunter's Mark lasts 48 hours, and while it's on a living enemy you need no sleep and ignore malnutrition and dehydration.

features.name: Predator's Intuition
features.desc: When Bolas or a Special Shot hits a Large or bigger creature, you learn its remaining Hit Points.

features.name: Finish the Hunt
features.desc: Once per Long Rest as an Action, with a one-liner, a ranged attack automatically hits a visible Large or bigger creature within 60 feet: it dies if it has 100 HP or fewer, otherwise takes 10d10 + 30 Piercing.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.desc: Intelligence-based. Cantrips: Poison Spray, Mending, Spare the Dying. Slots usable only for Bonesmith spells (as an Eldritch Knight-style third caster, up to level 4 slots at 19). Always prepared: Inflict Wounds, False Life, Find Familiar (3); Ray of Enfeeblement, Alter Self, Protection from Poison (7); Speak with Dead, Animate Dead, Fear (13); Blight, Fabricate, Death Ward (19). Focus: Smith's or Leatherworker's Tools or a weapon you crafted.

features.name: Body Knowledge
features.desc: Use Intelligence for attack and damage rolls with weapons you crafted with Melder of Flesh and Bone.

features.name: Grim Harvest
features.desc: Harvest hide, bone, horn, and fangs from fresh carcasses (more and slower for bigger creatures; two helpers halve the time).

features.name: Melder of Flesh and Bone
features.desc: Proficiency with Leatherworker's Tools, Smith's Tools, and Medicine. Over a Long Rest, craft armor, shields, weapons, and trinkets from harvested parts.

features.name: Improved Crafting
features.desc: Your crafted items are +1.

features.name: Construct of Flesh
features.desc: Over a Long Rest, build a Medium Undead companion (AC 15, HP 5 + 5 per Fighter level, Str 18, Dex 16) with one trait (Arboreal, Volant, Nocturnal, Robust, or Nimble) and one attack (+4 + PB, 1d10 + PB plus 1d6 Necrotic, with a rider: poison, prone, acid range, or fear). It acts after you and only Dodges unless you spend a Bonus Action to command it.

features.name: Artisan Crafter
features.desc: Your crafted items are +2.

features.name: Improved Construct of Flesh
features.desc: Add a second trait, and you can forgo attacks of your Attack action to let the construct attack.

features.name: Body Modification
features.desc: Over a Long Rest, fuse up to three crafted items (one armor or up to two weapons per rest) into your body; draw or conceal weapons as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Master Crafter
features.desc: Your crafted items are +3.

features.name: Combat Bonesmithing
features.desc: During the Attack action, spend 10 harvested resources (rising by 10 each use until a Long Rest) to replace one attack with a one-Action Bonesmith spell.

features.name: Minion Master
features.desc: Construct gets +2 AC, a second attack, and +2d6 Necrotic on its attacks; once per Long Rest it drops to 1 HP instead of 0.

features.name: Flesh from Shadow
features.desc: Once per Long Rest cast Creation without a slot, optionally making a harvestable beast carcass up to Large that lasts 24 hours (its products last a week).

features.name: Circle of Cycles Spells
features.desc: Always prepared: Augury, Evolution/Devolution (3); Clairvoyance, Tongues, Meld into Stone (5); Legend Lore, Contact Other Plane (9); Find the Path, Contingency, Flesh to Stone, Circle of Death (13); Foresight, Glibness, Time Stop (17).

features.name: Adaptive Wild Shape
features.desc: Each Wild Shape adds one: +30 climb (or +20), +15 fly (or +10; DM may limit to Tiny and Small until level 8), water breathing and +30 swim (or +20), Darkvision 60 (or +30), or one attack dealing Acid or Poison.

features.name: Glimpse Future
features.desc: Advantage on Dexterity saves, and use your Reaction to give an ally you can see Advantage on a Dexterity save if they can hear you.

features.name: Improved Evolution/Devolution
features.desc: Evolution/Devolution gains 30-foot range and Bonus Action casting; harmful changes also deal 1d8 + Wisdom Necrotic (half on a save). Cast it once per Long Rest at level 2 without a slot.

features.name: Deep Hibernation
features.desc: Hibernate for 24+ hours without aging or needs, waking with a Long Rest and a chosen apparent age; commune with the past or a possible future for lore.

features.name: Improved Glimpse Future
features.desc: Evasion on Dexterity saves, and use your Reaction to grant it to an ally who can hear you.

features.name: Cosmological Evolution
features.desc: Once per Long Rest as an Action: darkness or daylight over 10 miles for 10 minutes, or for 1 minute you and allies within 15 feet reroll one missed melee attack, missed ranged attack, or failed save per turn (your pick).

features.name: Guided Evolution
features.desc: Concentrate on Evolution/Devolution for 10 minutes to make it last until recast or the target's next Long Rest.

features.name: Future Sight
features.desc: Once per Long Rest as an Action, for 1 hour you have Advantage on attacks and attacks against you have Disadvantage (not while Incapacitated or Blinded).
